event_description: Fired when a shopper lands on a listing detail page, the top of the buy funnel.
Fired when a logged-in user toggles a listing into their favorites (heart button).
Fired when a logged-in user removes a listing from their favorites (heart button).
Fired server-side when a buyer successfully adds a listing to their cart.
Fired when a buyer reaches the checkout page with a listing or cart in their session.
Fired server-side when the buyer lands on the purchase confirmation page after a successful payment.
Fired server-side in the Stripe finalize-order API route after a successful payment intent is recorded as a completed order.
Fired server-side when a buyer successfully submits an offer on a listing.
Fired server-side when a seller accepts a pending offer.
Fired server-side when a buyer or seller sends a marketplace listing message.
Fired when a seller lands on /sell, /sell/boards, or any other /sell category flow.
Fired once per session when a seller starts filling a category sell form.
Fired when a seller submits the publish action on any /sell flow.
Fired when a listing publish succeeds on any /sell flow.
Fired client-side when a seller successfully publishes a new listing or re-publishes a draft in the sell flow.
Fired client-side when a user successfully creates a new account via the email sign-up form.
Fired client-side when a user successfully signs in with email and password.
